Diversity can be achieved either by integrating multiple heterogeneous base learners or providing different training subsets to each base classifier. A heterogeneous classifier ensemble results in better predictive performance than an individual classifier. Stacking ensemble method is proposed in this work, integrating Naïve Bayes, Support Vector Machine and Random Forest algorithms, as Stacking method, combines the advantages of individual base classifiers and the two-stage learning process of Stacking ensemble leads to better relevance prediction than individual classifiers. This study aims to improve the performance of the classification system by retrieving Indian academician web pages from foreign universities’ websites. The feature set for classification consists of URL text and web page content. Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency vectorization assigns feature weights to determine the relevancy of a web page. This work compares the performance of the proposed method with individual classifiers.

articleTitle: Automation of Question-Answer Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 Fourth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In this paper, an automatic system is proposed to generate different kinds of questions and answers from the input text. Question answer generation systems have been an interesting field of research for over decades. From generating questions for educational purposes to preparing answers to questions that could be asked in a legal proceeding, the purpose of question answer generation(QAG) systems is to reduce the tedious task of going through large texts. In our system, question-answer pairs from a given input text are generated using linguistic and statistical knowledge of text. Initially, those sentences are identified from the input text on which questions can be framed and in further steps, identified sentences are ranked in an order of importance. Built specifically for assessment purpose, the system generates multiple choices, fill-ups, true-false, binary and wh type questions based on high ranked sentences in the last step. In performance evaluation of the proposed system, it is found that the system is performing well and it is close to state of art research in the standard linguistic approach.

articleTitle: A study on Strategies of Trading the News Using Massive Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 Fourth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Predicting the correlation between the events and price movement is quiet challenge in the dynamic environment. The refreshing rate of stock price results huge volume of data and therefore forecasting the financial series is chaotic and stochastic. The volume participation of share is determined by other facts including sectorial or individual share news and it leads to volume increased and price increased shares in the nonlinear market. Most of the times the price relies on mathematical model rather than news or information shared in the media. New investors find it is difficult to consider either news or mathematical models for prediction. Our proposed model recommends decision to novice traders to avoid such loses in their portfolio using massive data. Using this approach, an investor can see the impact of an event and its outcome instead of betting on the shares randomly and reduce the false effect on trading the news.

articleTitle: A Holistic Review on Optimization Strategies for C & K Metrics in Object Oriented Testing
publicationTitle: 2021 Fourth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Software maintenance in software engineering has been considered as the modification of a software product. This procedure is taken after delivery in order to correct faults. It is also helping in improving the performance or other attributes. General perception of maintenance is that it is considering and fixing defects. Many studies are presenting that lot of maintenance effort has been utilized during non-corrective actions. Research is considering the existing researches in field of to software maintenance effort along with problem statements. The issues with existing researches are also presented in this research. Research paper is supposed to lay better foundation for upcoming findings in field of software maintenance effort.
